reading_note: The teaching describes regeneration as four discrete combats between divine truth and the loves of self/falsity. Each war corresponds to a distinct degree: (1) First Man = celestial truth descending and being mingled with self-love so that something divine is held captive within it; (2) Living Spirit = spiritual operative power that imprisons the falsities and constructs an ordered cosmos (the new natural mind); (3) Third Ambassador = the awakening call that draws out the captive good from the archonic states by displaying purity and richness as a lure; (4) Jesus the Splendour = divine truth in ultimates that strips, judges, completes the work, and seals the regenerated state forever, conjoining the soul to the Greatness through Call and Answer. The arc moves from initial mingling → binding of evils → separation of good from evil → final glorification and eternal rule.
